name: 61832 · Danville, IL
findings: ZIP 61832 (Danville) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61832 (Danville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
